title: ICP Objective Function
equation: E = (1/n) × Σ||p_i - (R × q_i + t)||²  → minimize over R, t
applicability: Point-to-point ICP. Point-to-plane variant: E = (1/n) × Σ((p_i - (R×q_i+t)) · n_i)² where n_i is normal at p_i. Converges faster for planar scenes. Typical convergence: 20–100 iterations to sub-mm RMS.

title: Statistical Outlier Removal Threshold

d_threshold.description: Maximum allowable mean distance to k neighbors

applicability: Points with mean neighbor distance > threshold are classified as noise and removed. k = 6–12 neighbors typical. Lower n_σ = more aggressive filtering (risk removing real points). Higher n_σ = more conservative.

title: Cloud-to-Cloud Distance (C2C)
equation: d_C2C(p) = min(||p - q_j||)  for all q_j in reference cloud

d_C2C.description: Shortest distance from point p to reference cloud

applicability: Simplest distance metric. Unsigned (always positive). Sensitive to point density differences and surface roughness. For signed distances and better uncertainty estimation, use M3C2.

title: M3C2 Distance (Multiscale Model-to-Model Cloud Comparison)

d_M3C2.description: Signed distance along surface normal direction

c₁.description: Mean position of points within projection cylinder in cloud 1

c₂.description: Mean position of points within projection cylinder in cloud 2

n̂.description: Surface normal estimated at scale D (normal estimation diameter)

applicability: Computes distance along local normal direction (not nearest-point). Provides uncertainty estimate: LoD_95% = ±1.96 × √(σ₁²/n₁ + σ₂²/n₂ + reg²). Core algorithm for deformation monitoring from point clouds. Two key parameters: D (normal scale) and d (projection cylinder diameter).

title: Voxel Grid Subsampling
equation: p_voxel = (1/n_v) × Σp_i  for all p_i in voxel

p_voxel.description: Representative point (centroid of points in voxel)

p_i.description: Original points falling within the voxel

applicability: Divides 3D space into regular cubes (voxels) of edge length L. One representative point per occupied voxel. Produces uniform point spacing regardless of original density. Reduction factor depends on original density vs. voxel size.

title: Surface Roughness from Point Cloud
equation: σ_roughness = √((1/k) × Σ(d_i²))  where d_i = distance from point to local best-fit plane

σ_roughness.description: Local surface roughness (RMS deviation from fitted plane)

d_i.description: Distance from each neighbor to fitted plane

k.description: Number of neighbors used for local plane fit

applicability: Roughness = smallest eigenvalue of local PCA. Scale-dependent — different k values yield different roughness. For rock joint roughness: JRC correlation from 3D roughness parameters (Z2, SF, Rp) computed from point cloud profiles.

title: Point Density Estimation
applicability: Estimates 2D surface density (appropriate for TLS/ALS on surfaces). For 3D volumetric density: ρ_3D = k / (4/3 × π × r_k³). Density maps identify areas of insufficient coverage for analysis.

title: RANSAC Plane Fitting — Inlier Count Threshold

p.description: Desired probability of finding correct model (typically 0.99)

applicability: For 50% inliers and 99% success: N = log(0.01)/log(1-0.5³) = 35 iterations. For 20% inliers: N = 573 iterations. RANSAC is robust to outliers but requires enough iterations. Distance threshold for inlier classification typically 2–5× measurement noise.
